bullets: Engineered a Java/Spring Boot pipeline that decouples CMS quality reporting from a legacy Perl/Oracle monolith, extracting enrollment and measure results from Snowflake and publishing Kafka change events to scoring services.
Led multi-region DR (us-west-2 failover) for 5+ production services via Terraform; drove SonarQube hardening.
Built an internal smart contract SDK and led API development for third-party DeFi integrations.
Built a backend relayer that batches users' Starknet vault deposits, bridges them to Ethereum with StarkGate and supplies them to Aave and Compound, so many users share one L1 transaction's gas.

entries.title: Google Summer of Code
bullets: Developed, tested and deployed an oracle adapter for Djed, a crypto-backed stablecoin on EVM networks.
Worked on Djed Shu's converter from 1-price to 2-price oracles, tracking 24-hour max and min prices.

entries.title: Haystack
bullets: Built private address sync for Bitcoin light wallets: each real address is queried from an Electrum server among HMAC-derived decoys, so the server can't easily tell which addresses are the wallet's.
Wrote an attacker module that tries to pick out the real addresses and scores the remaining privacy in bits.

entries.title: web3-dream11
bullets: Built a fantasy-cricket marketplace on Base Sepolia where teams bid for players in on-chain auctions.
Used Chainlink Automation to run the auction clock and Chainlink Functions to fetch player rankings.

entries.title: Djed Shu: A Stablecoin Protocol with Two Oracle Prices
bullets: Co-authored a paper on Djed Shu, a stablecoin that uses two oracle prices to resist manipulation and delays.

Wrote the paper's stability proofs (Theorems 1–8) for the two-price setting, and its sections on how the rolling-window oracle affects the price spread and on empirical validation with on-chain data from Zephyr.

entries.title: Starknet AI Agent Hackathon - Shikamaru Protocol
bullets: Architected a decentralized mutual fund on Starknet where multi-agent AI (Eliza) manages risk-stratified portfolios across lending protocols and AMM liquidity pools.
Built Cairo contracts (Pool Manager, Strategy Manager, Token Handler) for programmatic fund allocation.
